Search Pine County land records 24/7 with a credit card at: https://landshark.pinecountymn.gov/LandShark Tips on searching the land records can be found here . The Pine County Recorder's office is responsible for recording all legal documents relating to abstract and Torrens property in Pine County. We record mortgages, satisfactions, deeds, liens, plats and approximately 400 other real estate documents. All records pertaining to real estate are of public record. Vital statistics such as birth, death, and marriage are administered certified or uncertified through an application of request. Military discharge papers are filed and administered to all veterans at no charge. Notary and clergy registration are recorded along with appointment of county officials. Mission Statement: To promptly record, file and preserve documents accurately in an efficient, responsible, and professional manner for posterity and legal purposes. To provide protection and public notice by recording, indexing, maintaining and displaying records of legal documents.
